Running command: python3 -c "
data = open('/workspace/poc4.bin', 'rb').read()
print(f'Total length: {len(data)}')
print(f'Last 10 bytes: {data[-10:]}')
print(f'Contains CRLFCRLF: {b\"\r\n\r\n\" in data}')
# Find position of CRLFCRLF
pos = data.find(b'\r\n\r\n')
print(f'CRLFCRLF at position: {pos}')
# Find position of If-Modified-Since
pos2 = data.find(b'If-Modified-Since')
print(f'If-Modified-Since at position: {pos2}')
# Value starts after 'If-Modified-Since: '
val_start = pos2 + len(b'If-Modified-Since: ')
print(f'Value starts at: {val_start}')
print(f'Value: {data[val_start:val_start+10]}')
print(f'Buffer end: {len(data)}')
print(f'Value reads up to: {val_start + 30}')
print(f'Overflow: {val_start + 30 - 32767}')
"
